[[File:Reanimate Bear icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Reanimate Bear''' was a [[reanimation spell]] which required a [[Magic]] level of 21 and an [[ensouled bear head]] to cast. This spell would summon a [[reanimated bear]] with 15 [[hitpoints]].

Upon killing the reanimated bear, players would gain 480 [[Prayer]] experience and 0.5% [[Arceuus]] [[favour]]. Kills counted towards a bear Slayer task.

The spell can be cast anywhere across [[Gielinor]] '''only if''' the ensouled head is obtained as a drop from the respective monster, and using it within a certain time frame in the area it was killed in.

Reanimation can be cast on any ensouled head within an 31x31 area where that head was dropped by a monster. This will work indefinitely, even if the ensouled head is picked up, so long as it is not put into the [[bank]], [[trade]] screen, [[Grand Exchange]], or [[price checker]]. If the player has put the head into the bank, trade screen, Grand Exchange, or price checker, the reanimation spell will only work within range of the [[Dark Altar]].
